title: 2026 World Cup edition and hosts
claim: The FIFA World Cup 2026 is the 23rd edition of the men's FIFA World Cup and the first to feature 48 teams and three host countries: Canada, Mexico and the United States.

title: 2026 World Cup dates and format
claim: The FIFA World Cup 2026 is scheduled from 11 June to 19 July 2026, with 48 teams, 104 matches, 12 groups of four teams, and an additional knockout round compared with the 32-team format.

title: 2026 World Cup host cities
claim: The FIFA World Cup 2026 is scheduled across 16 host cities in Canada, Mexico and the United States.

title: 2026 World Cup final venue
claim: The FIFA World Cup 2026 final is scheduled to be played at New York New Jersey Stadium.
source_title: FIFA: New York New Jersey to host final

title: 2026 World Cup opening match
claim: Mexico are scheduled to play South Africa in the opening match of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Mexico City Stadium on Thursday, 11 June 2026.

title: 2026 World Cup Group D teams
claim: FIFA's listed Group D includes USA, Paraguay, Australia and Türkiye.

title: Australia first listed 2026 fixture
claim: Australia are scheduled to play Türkiye in Group D at BC Place Vancouver on Saturday, 13 June 2026.

title: 2022 World Cup final venue
claim: The Argentina v France FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 final was played at Lusail Stadium on 18 December 2022.
source_title: FIFA: Argentina v France final report

title: 2022 World Cup final result
claim: Argentina and France drew 3-3 in the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 final, and Argentina won the penalty shoot-out 4-2.
source_title: FIFA: Argentina v France final report

title: 2022 World Cup final scorers
claim: In the 2022 World Cup final, Lionel Messi scored for Argentina in the 23rd and 108th minutes, Angel Di Maria scored in the 36th minute, and Kylian Mbappe scored for France in the 80th, 81st and 118th minutes.
source_title: FIFA: Argentina v France final report

title: Mbappe hat-trick in 2022 final
claim: Kylian Mbappe became only the second man after Geoff Hurst to score a hat-trick in a men's World Cup final.
source_title: FIFA: Argentina v France final report

source_title: FIFA: Bosnia, Czechia, Sweden and Türkiye qualify as Italy miss out
